capabilities: Show assigned Linear issues as a kanban board in a daily note
Change an issue's status by dragging cards between columns or using the status menu
Refresh the board automatically about once a minute or on demand
Open an issue in the Web viewer sidebar
Choose which team and status columns the board shows
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; the API key is kept in Obsidian's secret storage. Interface available in English and Korean. Building from source needs Node.js 22.18 or later.
problem: Checking and updating the status of assigned Linear issues means leaving the note you are writing and switching to Linear.

relations.evidence: Move a card to another column to change the issue's status in Linear.
Click an issue title to open it in the web viewer in the right sidebar. This requires the core plugin Web viewer.

summary: Kanban board of your assigned Linear issues inside daily notes, where dragging a card changes the issue's status in Linear.
